speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)

The clinical picture of a 33-week premature infant presenting with immediate respiratory distress, cyanosis, and an acidotic arterial blood gas with elevated carbon dioxide is classic for RDS. Tuberculosis is highly unlikely in a newborn born just two hours ago with these specific findings. I am ready to proceed with the diagnosis based on this evidence.
